newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator rises 5 cents to 623c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator rises 5 cents to 623c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose five cents to 623 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mostly dearer, with 19/24 microns 0.5 percent dearer, 20m two percent dearer, 21/22/23m one percent dearer, 25m unchanged and 26m slightly cheaper, it said.
Merino skirtings were fully firm, while in crossbreds, 27/31m were slightly dearer, 28m unchanged and 29/30 were 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were slightly dearer, carbonising locks up to two percent cheaper and crutchings unchanged.
WI said Japanese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 25,277 bales offered, 8.7 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 45,000 bales to be offered.
